habits.boundary_condition: Treat the window seat as a preference rather than a reason to replace an otherwise acceptable flight
habits.condition: When selecting seats for an outbound or return flight
habits.default_action: Request or reserve a window seat when one is available
habits.exception_condition: Skip the window-seat request if accommodating it would disrupt the selected flight
habits.name: Prefer window seats on flights
habits.rationale: Across three independent flight-planning conversations, the user repeatedly requests and confirms window seating; one conversation explicitly shows willingness to retain the flight without it, supporting a soft default rather than a hard requirement.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports a window-seat preference with an explicit fallback to keep the chosen flight if the seat request causes a conflict.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Okay. Well, then I'll skip the window seat if that messes up this flight.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports applying the window-seat preference to the return flight as well as the outbound flight.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: That will work, and I'd like to have a window seat with that too, please.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently states window seating as a flight preference during search.
